name: com.nicofetter/spain-remote-jobs-agent
title: Spain remote jobs
description: Open Spain-employable roles at startups on the public directory, and why each startup is listed.

tools.name: find_jobs
tools.description: Open Spain-employable roles from jobs.json. Filter by role (title text), text (title, company, location, or posting text), eligibility class (spain-named, eu-eea, worldwide, contractor), and min_stated_pay when the posting states pay. Roles with no stated pay are left out of a pay filter. When nothing matches, empty.filter names the filter that removed every match.

role.description: Words to find in the role title.

text.description: Words to find in the title, company, location, or posting text.

min_stated_pay.description: Keep postings whose stated pay (max, or min when there is no max) is at least this figure, in the posting's own currency and period. Postings with no stated pay are dropped.

tools.name: get_startup
tools.description: One company from directory.json: why it passed the startup gate, with the stored evidence (hand, YC, or headcount plus a URL).
